title: The thermal runaway mechanism of fast-charging lithium-ion batteries using LiFSI-based electrolytes
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE05762K, Paper
Weizhen Fan, Yifan Sha, Jianan Zhang, Litao Shi, Anfei Wang, Hai Su, Keming Song, Yan-Bing He, Junmin Nan
The thermal runaway mechanism of LiFSI-based batteries is firstly revealed in which tremendous heat is released due to N2 generated via decomposition of LiFSI. Quenching N-containing free radicals is put forward to improve battery safety.
